meta.join: DOB property ZIP (postcode) ⋈ DOF sale ZIP (zip_code)

sources.label: DOB NOW: Build – Job Application Filings
NYC Citywide Annualized Calendar Sales Update
HPD Housing Maintenance Code Violations (risk overlay)

method.signal: Year-over-year change in the trailing 3 months (March 2026–May 2026 vs. the same period a year earlier) in New Building filings (supply) and recorded sales (demand), joined by property ZIP.
method.threshold: A move of ±15% YoY counts as up/down. To qualify, a ZIP needs ≥8 filings and ≥45 sales this quarter, each off a year-ago base of ≥4 / ≥25 (avoids small-number noise).
method.note: Supply and demand use the same trailing quarter (transactions lag ~2 months, so that quarter governs). Each ZIP also carries its affordability read (income-to-buy gap, renter cost burden, and price-vs-income divergence class) from the Census ACS. Divergence flags are computed facts; interpretation requires review.
